scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You got rid of Bangungot!
The nurse might be waiting for you
in front of the hospital!
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你消灭了噩梦死神般滚勾特！
护士可能在医院门口等你！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
..........

[Nurse Maenne]
Now the entrance
to go up second floor
is closed.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
现在通往二楼的入口已经关闭了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
To go up
the second floor again
Open the gate
after lapse of time.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
想要再次上二楼，
请在时间流逝后打开大门。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
From the Bangungot at second floor
You returned safely to here!!
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你从二楼的噩梦死神般滚勾特那里
安全地回到了这里！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
If you want to go up
second floor again
Please come to me.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
如果你想再次上二楼，
请再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
.......

[Nurse Maenne]
.....?
Now you can't go up
to the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
.....?
现在你无法上二楼了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
This is fatal situation.
that is why you can't go up
2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
这是致命的情况。
这就是为什么你无法上二楼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
To the second floor of hospital
Do you want go up second floor again?
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
医院二楼
你想再次上二楼吗？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You have too much stuff.
Please reduce your stuff and
come to me again.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你的物品太多了。
请减少物品数量，
然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It's too heavy.
Please reduce the weight and
come to me again.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
太重了。
请减轻重量，
然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
.......

[Nurse Maenne]
- The door is closed to 1st floor
when this Nurse came in?
I call her behind but
She doesn't respond. -
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
- 当我进来时，通往一楼的门是关着的？
我喊她，
但她没有回应。 -

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You returned safely from the Bangungot on the second floor!!
However, it's not
really over yet.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你从二楼的噩梦死神般滚勾特那里安全回来了！！
但是，
事情还没有真正结束。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I'm pretty sure it
never disappears easily.
I don't know what will happen
about Bangungot, so
after a lapse of time
please return to me.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
我很确定它不会轻易消失。
我不知道噩梦死神般滚勾特会发生什么，
所以在时间流逝后，
请回来找我。

scripts.text:
- I guess...
I can't talk him alone.
After registering a party
let me try to say something. -
scripts.translation:
- 我想...
我无法单独和他说话。
组建队伍后，
让我试着说点什么。 -

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You are back...
There is bad news.
I heard that
the Bangungot is appeared
again.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
你回来了...
有个坏消息。
我听说
噩梦死神般滚勾特又出现了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I already heard that story so
I pretty much know that.
What are you going to do?
Do you want to go up
to the second floor?
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
我已经听过那个故事了，
所以我很清楚。
你打算怎么做？
你想上二楼吗？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
{0} 's help
is needed again.
Please could you give me
one more chance?
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
{0} 大人，
我又需要您的帮助了。
请再给我一次机会，好吗？

scripts.text: Enter the second floor.
scripts.translation: 进入二楼

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
A critical situation has happened.
You can't go up to the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
发生了紧急情况。
您现在不能上二楼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
We are preparing to go up
to the second floor.
At the second floor
there is a chaotic rumor that
the dead do not die.
Please refer to this story.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
我们正在准备前往二楼。
二楼流传着一个混乱的谣言，
说死者不会死去。
请查阅这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
When you finish everything,
please talk to me again.
I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
完成所有事情后，
请再回来找我。
真的非常感谢您。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
A critical situation has happened.
You can't go up to the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
发生了紧急情况。
您现在不能上二楼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
You can't go up to
the 2nd floor now.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
您现在不能上二楼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It's too dangerous to go
up to the 2nd floor alone.
Please come here with
several people.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
独自上二楼太危险了。
请带上几个人一起来。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Alright.
If you change mind, come back again.
scripts.translation:
[护士 梅恩]
好的。
如果您改变主意，请再回来。
